 Al Nassr vs. Neom SC Lineups, Live Streaming, How & Where to Watch Saudi Pro League on TV
 Pragjyoti Singh 2026년 10월 20일 화 오후 4:00 UTC 0 Al Nassr host Neom in a Saudi Pro League fixture today at the Al-Awwal Park.
 Ange Postecoglou’s side enters the match sitting 3rd in the standings with 19 points and boasting one of the most effective defenses in the league, having only conceded seven goals all season. 
 In attack, Cristiano Ronaldo leads the line and has already scored four goals so far, alongside Joao Felix and Sadio Mane. 
 Meanwhile Neom SC is adjusting to life in the top tier remarkably well, occupying 5th in the table with 16 points.
 Sadio Mane and Al-Nassr FC Players celebrate with the fans after the Saudi Pro League game between Al Nassr and Al Ittihad.Photo by Abdullah Ahmed/Getty Images Former Lyon and Arsenal striker Alexandre Lacazette leads the attack and has scored five goals this season, making him a major threat on the counter-attack. They are coming off a 1-0 loss to Al Ettifaq but they have been a tough side during away matches, winning three of their last six away fixtures.
 Al Nassr vs. Neom Official Lineups
 Al Nassr: 
 Advertisement
 Bento; Washl, Martinez, Al Amri, Yahya; Costa, Angelo, Mane, Al Khaibari; Felix, Ronaldo.
 Neom SC: 
 Bulka; Al Dossary, Zeze, Sarr, Al Burayk; Taha, Al Hassan, Al Oyayari, Al Absi; Lacazette, Benrahma.
 How and Where to Watch Al Nassr vs. Neom SC
 Today’s Saudi Pro League kicks off at 2:00 PM EDT (9:00 PM local time in Saudi Arabia).
 In the United States, fans can watch the game via FOX Soccer Plus or FOX Deportes for the Spanish broadcast. Streaming is available on Fubo, DirecTV Stream, the FOX Sports App, and foxsports.com.
 In Saudi Arabia, the local broadcast is available through the Thmanyah network and the JACO app.
